name: E-Tranzact
source: eTRANZACT International Plc Annual Report 2025, Report of the Directors operating results p.4 (N thousands): revenue 30,610,184 and 29,896,490, gross profit 14,311,201 and 11,359,158, operating profit 3,951,745 and 4,661,951, profit before income tax 4,199,136 and 4,897,062, income tax 1,729,469 and 1,503,730, profit after tax 2,469,667 and 3,393,332, basic and diluted earnings per share 27 and 37 kobo. The stored FY2024 figure was the year itself

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.derivedCellFormula: Profit Before Tax = Net Profit + Income Tax

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

unitNormalised.basis: market-cap anchored: cap 1.012e+11, net profit 3.39333e+06, revenue 3.06102e+07; at x1000 P/E 29.82, P/S 3.306

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2021; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
